Name: yassified wizard portraits
Author: deleted56164987
Description:
[size=4]disclaimer! my mods still work, however, in order to use the seasonal version, you must use the legacy version instead of
the most recent one.[/size]

updated!! i fixed some visual mistakes and softened his color palette. also his mustache is now slightly bigger; this was crucial.

-----------------------------

this mod has two versions, vanilla and seasonal. plus compatible portraits for romanceable rasmodius. (not SVE compatible!)

- vanilla will only replace his main outfit. after downloading, drop it inside your mods folder.

- seasonal replaces all of his outfits with brand new ones. you will need Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by Poltergeister in order for it to work. after downloading it, drop the 'assets' folder inside [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and let it override.

- for romanceable rasmodius, drop the assets inside the main folder and let it override. my mod only replaces his vanilla sprites version.

 -----------------------------

thank you so much for the endorsements and kind comments! i really appreciate it :]
